$comment: What FRIDAY needs installed to run, build, test, search, convert, containerise and use the GPU. scripts/prefetch-toolkit.cjs installs every entry of `prefetch` before the EXE is built, whatever its size, through the Install Manager job. There is no size cap: `onDemand` is by kind, not by size. Big AI models are chosen in the Models section, and the heavy runners and GPU stacks that only a model needs (PyTorch, the Hugging Face runner, vLLM) come from the Install Manager when that model is used. `elevated` entries need an administrator prompt and may ask for a restart; `requires` gates an entry on this PC's hardware.
